about: Retrieval evaluation sample: candidate pairs from both paths for manual judgement, and source exchanges for finding related testimony neither path retrieved. References only; the review CSVs carry the text. Evaluation fields are null until reviewed (true / false / 'unsure').

fields.correctAttribution: Both statements are the witness's own (or a question he plainly adopted), as cited.
fields.sameProposition: Both are about the same proposition or event.
fields.potentialContradiction: They could conflict as stated; to be adjudicated.
fields.insufficientContext: Can't tell without more surrounding testimony.
fields.worthLawyerReview: A lawyer preparing cross-examination would want to see this pair.
